newsitem.title: USA: Devon 1996 oil, gas production 10.7 MMBoe.
newsitem.headline: Devon 1996 oil, gas production 10.7 MMBoe.

text.p: Devon Energy Corp said on Monday its 1996 oil and gas production was 10.7 million barrels of oil equivalent.
In 1995, Devon said it increased total production by five percent to 10 million barrels of oil equivalent.
The company said its proved oil and gas reserves were estimated to be 179 million barrels of oil equivalent as of year-end 1996.
Proved reserves at year-end 1996 were estimated to be 596 billion cubic feet of gas, 67 million barrels of oil and 13 million barrels of natural gas liquids, the company said.
Proved reserves at year end 1995 were 114 million barrels of oil equivalent, it said.
Devon said its year-end 1996 reserves had an estimated pre-tax 10 percent present value of $1.62 billion.
It said about $500 million of the increase in estimated pre-tax 10 percent present value resulted from changes in commodity prices and costs at year-end 1996, compared to year-end 1995.
